addons.name: SurvivorUI Classic
addons.author: morderous
addons.about: A branch of Survivor UI in the game's own look: everything movable, a run tracker, boss bars, a damage meter and more. Works on its own; with Survivor UI too, you pick one.

addons.name: ASBuilder
addons.author: cadoky
addons.about: A build planner and in-run tracker: plan a build for any class before the run, then a small window tells you what to take next.

addons.name: Azerloot
addons.author: Kindagrey
addons.about: The loot book: every boss drop, ring, trinket and amulet, a build planner, a chronicle of your runs and a wishlist that ticks itself.

addons.name: AZSSpellMeter
addons.author: kex0
addons.about: A per-spell damage meter: the same numbers as Damage Done, plus kills per spell and the spell a proc actually casts.

addons.name: KeijinUI
addons.author: KeijinDE
addons.about: A complete interface in one visual style, inspired by Dragonflight: it replaces the game's own HUD.

addons.name: SurvivorsDragonUi
addons.author: migwynkriid
addons.about: A HUD for Azeroth Survivors: run and boss bars, combat text, seven action buttons and counters for gold, kills and caches. Type /sdui in the game to set it up.
